title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours

scenes.narration: Tech news you need to know. FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours.

Takeoffs from airports throughout the US largely stopped on Friday after the FAA issued a national ground stop at 3:44PM ET "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety." More than four hours after the stop was issued, officials announced it was lifted at 8:15PM ET and that flights will resume.
This story was reported by The Verge and Wired.
